form.message: Your standard ALZ Corp acceptance is recorded for DEV Architecture only as assumed, tenant-unverified evidence. No private scope file or Azure reads are needed for that route. Only the ACR residency decision remains unanswered: Microsoft permits registry-artifact storage in the paired region. Choose whether to request a narrow ACR-only exception within Sweden or retain Sweden Central-only registry storage. The earlier highlighted option was not an answer. Any exception follows the Requirements owner and independent review; it does not change application-data residency or authorize deployment.

registry_residency_resolution.title: ACR artifacts — unresolved residency decision
registry_residency_resolution.description: The narrow exception would cover Microsoft-managed paired-region storage of registry artifacts within Sweden only. Workload compute, application data, Blob storage and backups stay Sweden Central-only; the existing Entra exception stays unchanged. No optional customer-configured geo-replication, other-service exception, GDPR certification or Azure-operation approval is implied.
enumNames: Request a registry-only exception for Microsoft-managed paired-region storage within Sweden
